headline: Should STERIS' (STE) Record Chemistries Investment and Dividend Hike Require Action From Investors?
summary: STERIS plc recently announced plans to invest US$600 million in its largest-ever manufacturing project, a 600,000 square-foot formulated chemistries Center of Excellence in North Carolina that will consolidate production and distribution and create about 335 jobs, while also increasing its quarterly dividend to US$0.69 per share for a 21st year of growth.
